gross_section_probes.basis: Illustrative gross-section demands only. Rebound probe=3×HIGH unsprung weight on ONE restraint; pivot=2×highest estimated body reaction plus40 kN lateral and separately40 kN longitudinal. Factors/forces are analyst probes, not accepted design events. No yield/fatigue/impact acceptance.
gross_section_probes.roll_note: Four side supports atY±285 require a combined incremental restoring stiffness greater than the body gravity term merely for static upright stability. This lower bound excludes dynamics, track twist, tolerances, side loads, spring unloading, friction and required safety margin; it is not a selected spring rate. Centre bearings assumed to carry all body load for conservative local radial probe; actual side-support sharing unresolved.
exclusions: Rod thread root and eye transition fatigue; castle-nut stripping and cotter geometry; stop-washer bending and contact pressure.
Lower clevis bending, axlebox weld group, cast/weldable material compatibility and bearing distortion.
Guide bracket bending load spread, prying, bolt preload/slip, tapped-thread stripping, local sideframe fatigue, cartridge flange bending and wear.
Crosshead/end welds, main-rail wall crippling/diaphragms, cage/cap bending, cap bolts and nut threads, combined bearing life and lubrication.
Accepted vertical, braking, traction, buff/draft, side thrust, derailment/separation and jacking events; impact energy/damping.
Body roll-support selection and complete leading-truck support, axle guidance, wheel unloading, drive/suspension compatibility.
